summary: Ming Shing Group Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held on August 25, 2026, where shareholders approved four resolutions including changing the company's English name from Ming Shing Group Holdings Limited to PMA Graphene Technology Group Inc., subject to Cayman Islands Registrar approval, and adopting an amended memorandum and articles of association. A total of 601,481,966 votes representing 99.095% of exercisable votes were cast, with over 99.99% approval. No deal terms, prices, or premiums were involved; the filing is a routine corporate action update and the name change is not classified as a covered special situation.
